outcome: The pricing package can price a quantity against volume tiers.

acceptance_criteria.text: The unit price for a quantity is the tier with the highest minimum that quantity reaches.

expected_verification.assertion: a quantity of 10 prices at the 10+ tier and 250 at the 100+ tier

acceptance_criteria.text: A quantity below every tier has no tiered price rather than a price of zero.

data_impact: None. Tiers are supplied per request.
rollout: The package is published first; callers adopt it in their own changes.
